author: Unity
description:
Until now, working with dictionaries in Unity usually meant relying on serialization callbacks, custom wrappers, or third-party extensions.

With Unity 6.6, built-in serialization support has landed, including a dedicated two-column view in the Inspector window for editing keys and values.

#GameDev #UnityTips #Unity3D #UnityLearn
title: Serialized dictionaries.
